purpose: Test whether committing the complete two-action structural prefix recovers value lost when only its first action is evaluated and executed.

policy.fallback: Current bounded P8 conservative decision, including its own candidate domain and five-scenario gate.
policy.candidate: Consecutive cut/shield prefix from budget_plan depth=2 width=4; collaboration requires two distinct legal structure actions.
policy.selection: Compare prefix arm with bounded-P8 fallback under scenarios 0-4; require positive mean and nonnegative minimum.
policy.audit: Require positive mean and nonnegative minimum under scenarios 5-12 without reselection.
policy.execution: Rejected/no-prefix decisions execute bounded-P8 fallback. Accepted full executes both structure actions with public legality checks before replanning.
policy.prediction_safety: Scenario latent first response drives only hypothetical environment transitions; visible contains only realized public returns; neither is written to Blackboard.

stages.name: diagnostic4-501
stages.unlock: Run first. Continue only if prefix_full has positive mean versus bounded_p8, no action failure, and at least one accepted two-action prefix.

stages.name: old22-501
stages.unlock: Only after diagnostic4-501 passes. Continue only if the 22-family mean is positive and losses do not show broad instability.

stages.name: old22-502-503
stages.unlock: Only after old22-501 passes. These are consumed development seeds, not holdout confirmation.

stop_rule: Stop and report failure if mean gain is nonpositive, there is no genuine two-action opportunity, action failures occur, or later consumed development repetitions show unstable losses.
